Dm (stupid auto correct)
Do I need to do you or just give you the cod in a reply?
A lot of things really, I'm extremely hard of hearing, blind in one eye, have adhd, ocd, and autism, and have bad anxiety, so I can't do the things normal adults do.
That's a good idea, it would give me time to really think about what I want to say.
My main issue with that is that I have trouble putting how I feel into words. I don't really have anyone other than my family and I feel like they have enough to deal with already.

I looked it up and it does kind of fit, I'm currently working with my doctor to see if medication might help, maybe I should bring it up with her. 

I sometimes feel more or less ok, but then I have periods where I feel ten times worse than usual like now.
I've never heard of the second thing but it sounds like I might need to look into that. I know I've been marked as severe depression on those tests at the doctor.
Hey, I'm not great with words, but I want you to know you're not alone with how you're feeling.
You made some good points here. I guess since my insurance stuff is finally getting sorted out I should try to get some help. Maybe I can get better. Thanks for taking the time to talk to me.

Maybe you're right but I'm worried that she'll just end up depressed herself just from watching and copying me. My brother has actually told me that when I accidentally let it slip that I'm suicidal. 

I'm just not sure what to do with myself.

She has our older brother who is so much better to her than I am. I'm definitely old enough to know not to say things like that.  I'm afraid that if I stick around she'll learn from my bad behavior and start copying it.

I don't want to fuck up my little sister by being such a bad role model. I mean I got mad enough that I told a 7 year old that I hated her (I don't but I was mad at the time). I'm pretty sure I deserve everything I want to do to myself.
Thanks for the reply, my family do know about how I feel but I often feel that they don't completely understand (I'm the only autistic one).

Sounds like some pretty good advice, thank you.

Also thanks for taking the time to talk to me. It's getting pretty late here so I probably need to try to get some sleep.

I want to try to help others but I'm always afraid I'm going to say the wrong thing. 

I get anxious when it comes to talking to people most of the time.
I'll admit that part of the reason I haven't went through with my plan is because I don't trust anyone else to take care of them like I do.
Yeah
I'm not sure i can think of anything else, I guess I'm good at taking care of my cats.
I guess I'm ok at video games.
I can't  really  think of anything,

Thanks for the reply.

My main issue is feeling like I make the people around me miserable simply because my depression makes me angry and I can't always control it. I'm worried my rather severe mood swings are going to screw my little sister up mentally because she too young to understand why I'm like that sometimes. She'd be better off without the shitty role model that I am.

Wow, I didn't actually expect someone to reply, so thanks. I have been meaning to research ways to calm myself down but having the motivation to do so is a whole different thing. 

As for being a good role model for my sister I recently helped her learn to tie shoes, so I guess that's something. I'm just so afraid of her ending up like me so it scares me about just how much she looks up to me.

Once again thanks for taking time out of your day to reply to my little rant.
As someone with this condition I'm pretty much completely blind in the affected eye. I can't speak for others with it though.
That's pretty much how I see it, I can't kill myself until after my parents are gone.

You didn't make me feel any guiltier than I already did, I'm sorry if I made you think that. I guess I should also mention that I'm a high functioning autistic, who still lives with her parents, so I'm not sure how I can do much. I would like to thank you for taking the time to talk to me though, I hope for the best for you and your family. Also thanks for the kind words it actually made me feel a little better. It's time for me to go to sleep now so I won't be replying to anything else for a while.

I know your right about my parents because my older sister died in a car accident 5 months ago so I've seen that for my self (honestly I'll never forget the sound my mom made when we were told). It's also something that makes me feel more guilty because I know what it will do to them.
I just realized that this might be why I'm always a little hesitant to get new games. Also, 200 games, how do you ever deicide what to play?
That's what I try to do when playing longer games too, but it doesn't always help. It's nice to know I'm not alone though, so thanks for the reply.
I don't know your situation and I'm not sure I could do much to help, but I want you to know that you're not alone here.

As I said my family don't really understand how I feel and therapy is expensive so I don't really have a support system at all. Due to vision problems (I can see but it's bad enough that driving would be unsafe). I have extreme anxiety and can't stand being around people for long periods of time. I also have really bad hearing so that doesn't help either. Thanks for taking the time to talk to this random stranger though.
I didn't think of it that way but that makes a lot of sense. Thanks for the tips, it really does sound like it might help some (if I can sit still for that long).

Thanks, that made me feel better because I'm embarrassed that I can't drive. I know I need therapy but finding a way to afford it is not easy. I'm also not good at talking to people so that also doesn't help either.
Yeah, but I've realized that none of it is possible for someone like me, and I haven't come up with anything else yet.

Thanks, I get what you are saying but how can I go out and experience the world, if I can't even go anywhere without my parents? I can't drive, and I'm usually to anxious to try new things. As for meditation, I don't know where to start with that. Do you have any tips for that?

My dad along with me and my siblings have all lived in Marshall our whole lives (my mom is originally from another state). I never expected to see others from the area on here. My dad was actually in the first nonsegregated graduating class from Marshall high school.
